content:
emma: FYI folks  manager finalization cutoff is EOD Monday for this cycle. If you expect any late reviewer submissions, follow the extension flow instead of just DMing me. Link: https://go.redwood/extension-requests :wave:
raj: Quick how-to for the extension form (paste this in the "reason" field):
```
- Person: <name>
- Manager: <name>
- Reason: short justification (e.g., medical, travel, tooling outage)
- New submit by (UTC): <timestamp>
- Approver: <manager or lead>
```
taylor: Will approved extensions push back calibration or the public timeline? :thinking_face:
emma: Short answer: no. Calibration sessions go ahead. Approved late submissions are included in the calibration notes but won't delay other teams. We avoid org-wide deadline drift unless >10% of managers ask.
nina: For score comparability, are we doing any cross-team normalization? Some managers asked about level skew.
marco: People Ops preference is to keep calibration qualitative. That said we will compute a small offset table to surface outliers (median difference by level) and surface to cal leads for discussion. No automatic rescaling of scores.
raj: tagging an example automation we'll run: 
`compute_median_offsets.py --cycle=2026q1 --by=level`
taylor: Thanks. One more: peer feedback visibility. Is the default still summarized?
emma: Default = summarized. Managers can opt-in to show raw comments by toggling the "show_raw" column in the master sheet. Please be mindful of sensitive comments; redact PII.
ops-bot: Reminder: Manager submission cutoff set to 1830540000 (Mon EOD). Auto-reminders will go to managers 48h and 6h before deadline.
marco: If you need a calibration lead for a specific org, @me or add to the 'cal leads' tab. Leads: please confirm you have time to review the offset flags before the session.
raj: I'll run a 15m walkthrough for managers on Friday to cover extension flow + sheet controls. Sign-up here: https://go.redwood/calendar/extension-walkthrough :calendar:
emma: Perfect. Please update the extension sheet if you're filing something and ping this thread so we can triage quickly. :thumbsup:
